name: rcsb
description: RCSB Protein Data Bank (rcsb.org): search 3D macromolecular structures by keyword, attribute or 3D shape, and fetch entry chains, sequence annotations, UniProt alignments, version history, ligand definitions and coordinate/FASTA files.

commands.name: search-structures
commands.summary: Full-text keyword search of PDB entries (e.g. 'hemoglobin'), with sorting and offset pagination; returns PDB IDs, titles, methods, organisms and ligands

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Sort key: relevance score or initial release date

params.name: direction
params.description: Sort direction. Use desc with the release date to get the newest entries first.

params.name: content_type
params.description: experimental = PDB entries; computational = computed structure models (CSM)

commands.name: search-structures-filtered
commands.summary: Keyword search of PDB entries refined by one facet filter (source organism, experimental method, etc.), with sorting and pagination

params.name: filter_attribute
params.description: Facet attribute to refine on (exact match)

params.name: filter_value
params.description: Exact facet value, e.g. 'Homo sapiens' for organism, or 'X-RAY DIFFRACTION', 'ELECTRON MICROSCOPY' or 'SOLUTION NMR' for exptl.method

commands.name: search-by-attribute
commands.summary: Search PDB entries by a structured attribute such as author name, source organism, gene name or experimental method

params.name: attribute
params.description: Search attribute path. Examples: audit_author.name, rcsb_entity_source_organism.ncbi_scientific_name, rcsb_entity_source_organism.rcsb_gene_name.value, exptl.method, struct.title

params.name: value
params.description: Value to match, e.g. 'HBB', 'Perutz, M.F.' or 'Homo sapiens'

commands.name: search-similar-assemblies
commands.summary: 3D shape similarity search: find biological assemblies structurally similar to a given entry's assembly

params.name: entry_id
params.description: PDB ID of the query structure

params.name: assembly_id
params.description: Assembly ID of the query structure (see get-structure-chains)

commands.name: suggest-search-terms
commands.summary: Autocomplete: suggested search terms (molecule names, keywords, organisms...) for a partial query, grouped by attribute

commands.name: get-structure-chains
commands.summary: List the assemblies and polymer chains (entity id, name, label/auth asym ids) of a PDB entry

commands.name: get-entry-instances
commands.summary: Get all polymer chains of a PDB entry, with molecule names, organisms, sequence lengths, method, resolution and assembly composition (Data API GraphQL)

commands.name: get-entity-instances
commands.summary: Get the chain instances of one polymer entity (e.g. 4HHB_2), with molecule name, organism, length, method and resolution (Data API GraphQL)

params.name: entity_ids
params.description: Polymer entity ID in the form <PDBID>_<entity number>, e.g. 4HHB_1

commands.name: get-sequence-alignment
commands.summary: Align a PDB entity or chain sequence to its UniProt reference sequence, with coverage and aligned regions (Sequence Coordinates API)

params.name: queryId
params.description: Entity ID (4HHB_2) when from=PDB_ENTITY, or chain instance ID (4HHB.B) when from=PDB_INSTANCE

commands.name: get-sequence-annotations
commands.summary: Get positional sequence annotations (Pfam domains, disorder, secondary structure, binding sites, unobserved residues, UniProt features) for a PDB chain or entity

params.name: queryId
params.description: Chain instance ID (4HHB.B) when reference=PDB_INSTANCE, or entity ID (4HHB_2) when reference=PDB_ENTITY

bodyTemplate.query:
query QueryAnnotations(
    $queryId: String!,
    $reference: SequenceReference!,
    $sources:[AnnotationReference!]!,
    $range:[Int!],
    $filters: [AnnotationFilterInput!]
){
    annotations(
        queryId:$queryId
        reference:$reference
        sources:$sources
        range:$range
        filters:$filters
    ){
        source
        target_id
        target_identifiers{
            target_id
            entry_id
            assembly_id
            entity_id
            asym_id
            interface_id
            interface_partner_index
        }
        features {
            type
            provenance_source
            description
            feature_id
            name
            value
            feature_positions {
                beg_seq_id
                end_seq_id
                beg_ori_id
                end_ori_id
                range_id
                open_begin
                open_end
                value
                values
            }
        }
    }
}

commands.name: get-structure-summary
commands.summary: Get the title and IDs of a PDB entry from its structure summary page

commands.name: get-structure-annotations
commands.summary: List the domain classification rows (SCOP/SCOPe, CATH, ECOD, etc.) for a PDB entry

commands.name: get-experimental-method
commands.summary: Get the experimental method (X-ray, EM, NMR...) and experiment page title for a PDB entry

commands.name: list-entry-versions
commands.summary: List the revision history of a PDB entry (version number, date, change type), with links to versioned files

commands.name: get-entry-fasta
commands.summary: Download the FASTA sequences of all polymer entities in a PDB entry as text

commands.name: get-entry-file
commands.summary: Fetch a PDB entry's coordinate file (mmCIF or legacy PDB) as text, either full or header-only

params.name: part
params.description: header = metadata only (small); view = full coordinates (can be large)

commands.name: get-ligand-definition
commands.summary: Get the chemical component definition (name, formula, synonyms, atoms, bonds) of a ligand as mmCIF text, e.g. HEM

params.name: ligand_id
params.description: Chemical component ID (1-5 chars), e.g. HEM, ATP, NAG

notes: Search commands return result_set items. 'identifier' is the PDB ID (or PDBID-assemblyId for assembly searches). The full response also has total_count. Paginate with start in steps of rows (25).
To get the newest entries first, use sort_by=rcsb_accession_info.initial_release_date and direction=desc.

ID formats: entry = 4HHB; polymer entity = 4HHB_1 (entry_entityNumber); chain instance = 4HHB.A (entry.labelAsymId). Use get-structure-chains or get-entry-instances to find valid entity and chain IDs.
search-by-attribute sends value as a string. Numeric range filters (such as resolution) were not captured in the recording and may need the public Search API (search.rcsb.org) instead.
Only experimental entries are returned by default. Ligand and polymer-entity result tabs were not captured, so searches return entries (or assemblies for 3D similarity).
get-entry-file with part=view and format=cif/pdb returns full coordinate files, which can be very large. Prefer part=header for metadata.

Data API (data.rcsb.org/graphql) and Sequence Coordinates API are public and need no auth. The GraphQL bodies used by the web app are replayed here verbatim. The pdbx_struct_assembly_gen selection in get-entry-instances was reconstructed because the recorded query was truncated.
robots.txt disallows /search/browse and /groups/summary, so they are not exposed.
